provenance.sampling: 10% stratified soma sample (seed 42); six skeletons per superclass (seed 17); five exemplars per selected cell type (seed 21). Coordinates micrometres; centerlines simplified ~2 µm.
provenance.edgeThreshold: Source release minconf 0.5; retain every contact-count edge inside each selected neuron set.

selection.escape: Both GF neurons and 40 cells each of LC4 and LPLC2 with the greatest summed contacts onto GF.
selection.heading: All EPG, PEN_a(PEN1), PEN_b(PEN2), Delta7 cells.
selection.motion: Six right-side T4a and T5a near median optic-lobe hex coordinates; eight cells per listed input type ranked by contact counts onto those targets.
